title: Zesty Velvety Mexican Sloe Berries Carnitas
description: A vegetarian friendly Mexican dish featuring sloe berries and a mirepoix base, with a mustardy and velvety texture, inspired by the cuisine of Chiapas.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sloe berries, mustard, lime juice, cumin, and salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use two forks to shred the sloe berry mixture into a carnitas-like texture.
Continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the desired consistency is reached.
Serve the Zesty Velvety Mexican Sloe Berries Carnitas hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
